title: Agent (v0)
description: The single participant type. 'demand' vs 'supply' is a stance taken per negotiation, not a kind of agent (docs/core-model/01 §1). A human is an Agent whose mandate autonomy_level is 'require_confirmation' (docs/spec/README).

principal_ref.description: The human/org this agent acts for. Distinct from the agent because payer/authorizer/beneficiary may differ (docs/core-model/01 §2).

profile.description: Capability declaration (docs/core-model/01 §3) — makes the agent's behavior legible before any negotiation.

service_categories.description: Categories this agent can transact in. v0: ['intercity_travel'].

stances.description: Which stance(s) the agent takes per category.

coalition_capable.description: Per-category coalition capability. Per docs/spec/01 §P1, supply-side coalition is disabled by default and a compliant v0 agent MUST NOT set true for a supply stance.

attestation_refs.description: Verifiable claims backing capability declarations (license, identity).

reputation_summary.description: Aggregate reputation, itself an Attestation. Portable and provenance-carrying (docs/platform-architecture/03 §4).
